mundo.title: Lawmakers Set to Elect Germany’s 1st Far-Right Statehouse Speaker Since 1945
mundo.snippet: After winning a state election last month, the AfD is now on the cusp of being the first far-right party to oversee a state Parliament since the Nazi era.
